title: 2.6–7. Oghayogagocchaka

verses.t: Oghaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe….
Yogaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe…. (Dvepi gocchakā āsavagocchakasadisā ninnānākaraṇā.)
